description: A scene (a theme's scene.json): a space every app draws, with Baude's things placed in it as live widgets, real and usable as they are in a window. Distances are metres; angles degrees; +y is up.

renderer.description: What the desktop draws it with: gl (the scene's own GL: lights, bloom), or gfx (pygfx: physically based materials, its environment's light, shadows, its backdrop, models), where pygfx is installed, else gl. gl, left out.

environment.description: An HDR image whose light everything reflects (gfx): left out for none.

backdrop.description: A sky image drawn behind everything (gfx): left out for the background colour.

exposure.description: How bright the frame's exposed, before its tone curve (gfx): 1, left out.

bloom.description: A glow round what's brighter than white: left out for none.
